label: Roles
description: What the unit is for: its job or target, never its mechanic (mechanics are patterns). A card has one primary role and up to two secondary roles. 'Requires' says what a unit needs before it can claim the role. Tie-breaks: use anti-X as the primary only if the game gives a bonus against X or calls the unit that; generalists are assault. Damage first is a raider, information first is a scout. A disabler acts on units, area denial acts on ground.

terms.label: Frontline assault
terms.description: Leads pushes, soaks damage and brawls at short to medium range.

terms.label: Anti-air
terms.description: Brings down aircraft and flying drones, in low air, high air or both.

terms.label: Artillery / siege
terms.description: Hits from very far or over cover; breaks defences and structures.

terms.label: Marksman / overwatch
terms.description: Holds long sightlines and picks off targets with precise shots.

terms.label: Scout / recon
terms.description: Finds, spots and marks enemies; usually fast and fragile.

terms.label: Infiltrator / saboteur
terms.description: Acts inside enemy units, lines or buildings: sabotage, steal, capture.

terms.label: Disabler / control
terms.description: Stops enemies from acting: stun, root, silence, freeze, slow.

terms.label: Raider / flanker
terms.description: Hits and runs, picking off isolated targets.

terms.label: Area denial
terms.description: Controls ground with mines, fire, turrets or fortifications.

terms.label: Buffer / aura
terms.description: Boosts nearby allies with auras, call-ins or team abilities (spotting belongs to scout).

terms.label: Engineer / builder
terms.description: Builds, captures or deploys structures and gadgets.

terms.label: Logistics
terms.description: Earns, carries or delivers resources for the team: harvesting, salvage, supply runs.
